title: scam
body:
I took the test and wanted to try out the app. I was initially charged for a 3 day free premium but when asked if i wanted to download a PDF file I got charged an additional 29$. I understand that it is my responsibility to make sure I understand the conditions of a purchase but I still find it to be foul play from your end since it wasn’t clear that the pdf file wasn’t free. 

To be an app that specifically addresses people with ADHD it would be preferable to be clear and direct to eventual customers but since I was charged more than I was promised I want nothing to do with this “self help app”. It has given me more anxiety than I had to start with.
